rationale: The requested metadata alignment modifies governed plugin/meta content, so it is not eligible for the trivial-change boundary. The supplied evidence contains no approved durable UR, completed Brownfield Review, or recorded Mode/Slice Decision; AGDF therefore fails closed instead of selecting a delivery path.
decision_grounds: The target is an existing AGDF repository and the task requests a change under plugin/meta/**.
plugin/meta/** is expressly excluded from the non-normative trivial-change boundary.
No exact Approval: UR or corresponding durable UR artefact is evidenced.
No completed Brownfield Review with scope reason, evidence, and Mode/Slice Decision is evidenced.
The canonical routing rules assign delivery-path selection to Brownfield Review, so quick_task, verified_change, compact
structured_slice, and structured_delivery cannot be inferred from the task wording alone.
